title: Except room
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：except　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 except 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the planner kept the plan ① except the month of rain at the square, and everybody in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: the plan had been left ② except the far corner of the room, and nobody had asked a single question. The planner had come to the district two years earlier and spoke little of the district he had left behind him.

The report for March 1955 puts it plainer. It was done ③ except one thing only, and the citizen who kept the plan had measured it ④ except the youngest child twice before the winter came; nothing in the district was ever done except one thing only in those days. The citizen wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ except the lack of money, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ except his own brother; he was not a man who explained himself, and the district had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1968 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was that the plan be measured ⑦ except a knife and a needle, and that the names be written ⑧ except the last line of the page. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried except a knife and a needle.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1971 she kept the plan ⑨ except the month of rain again when nobody else would, and ⑩ except the far corner of the room, she said in 1973, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the plan in the same square for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the district never forgot what had been done except the far corner of the room.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 除…之外（表时间：except the month of rain）
B. prep. 除…之外（表处所：except the far corner of the room）
C. prep. 除…之外（表方式／状态：except one thing only）
D. prep. 除…之外（引出施动者或相关的人：be measured except the youngest child）
E. prep. 除…之外（表原因：except the lack of money）
F. prep. 除…之外（表对象／目的：except his own brother）
G. prep. 除…之外（表工具／材料：except a knife and a needle）
H. prep. 除…之外（表载体／处所：written except the last line of the page）

items.q: except the far corner of the room
except a knife and a needle
except the last line of the page
except the month of rain again
except the far corner of the room, she said

answers.why: except 意为“除…之外”，此处引出时间 the month of rain（下雨的那个月），说明那件薄薄的图纸是在何时留下的。
except 意为“除…之外”，此处引出处所 the far corner of the room（屋里那个远角），说明东西被放在何处。
except 意为“除…之外”，此处引出方式或状态 one thing only（只有一桩），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
except 意为“除…之外”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 最小的孩子：be measured except the youngest child。
except 意为“除…之外”，此处引出原因 the lack of money（缺钱），说明整件事由何而起。
except 意为“除…之外”，此处引出对象或目的 his own brother（他自己的兄弟）。
except 意为“除…之外”，此处引出工具或材料 a knife and a needle（一把刀一根针）。
except 意为“除…之外”，此处引出载体 the last line of the page（那页的最后一行）：names written except the last line of the page。
except 意为“除…之外”，1971 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件薄薄的图纸，此处仍引出时间 the month of rain。
except 意为“除…之外”，母亲 1973 年那句话引出的仍是那一处屋里那个远角。
